activation_policy.CONFIGURED: Tracking URL exists and is bound to the intended source/placement/destination route.
activation_policy.VERIFIED: Configured URL was manually opened and confirmed to land on the intended destination.
activation_policy.ACTIVE: Verified URL is actually installed in the specified live placement.
activation_policy.rule: Do not mark a route ACTIVE merely because its URL works. Activate only after baseline lock and live placement.
